crossref.title: <scp>WSXM</scp>: A software for scanning probe microscopy and a tool for nanotechnology
crossref.abstract: <jats:p>In this work we briefly describe the most relevant features of WSXM, a freeware scanning probe microscopy software based on MS-Windows. The article is structured in three different sections: The introduction is a perspective on the importance of software on scanning probe microscopy. The second section is devoted to describe the general structure of the application; in this section the capabilities of WSXM to read third party files are stressed. Finally, a detailed discussion of some relevant procedures of the software is carried out.</jats:p>
